description_en: A node pool is a logical group of nodes with the same properties, enabling unified management and operations such as node upgrades and autoscaling. A node pool's automated features also reduce operations costs. For example, it can automatically remediate OS CVE vulnerabilities, recover failed nodes, and upgrade the kubelet and containerd. Call `CreateClusterNodePool` to create a node pool
description_zh: 节点池是具有相同属性的一组节点的逻辑集合，允许对节点进行统一的管理和运维，例如节点升级、弹性伸缩等。您可以进一步使用节点池的自动化运维能力，使用OS CVE漏洞自动修复、故障节点自动恢复、kubelet和containerd版本自动升级等功能，降低运维成本。您可以调用CreateClusterNodePool为集群创建节点池
kebab_example: aliyun ens create-cluster-node-pool --cluster-id eck-xxxxxxxx --nodepool-info Name=test1 --scaling-group '{"DesiredSize":3,"KeyPairName":"key-pair-name","DataDisks":[{"Category":"cloud_efficiency","Size":80}],"SystemDiskSize":80,"InstanceChargeType":"PostPaid","VswitchIds":["vsw-58eu2p6v64qw8ihhit1wz7wgv"],"ImageId":"m-6734fzvcwcv2o8jj201cpa7ox","InstanceTypes":["ens.sn1.small"],"SystemDiskCategory":"cloud_efficiency","Password":"some-test-password"}' --kubernetes-config PreUserData=ZWNobyBvawo= UserData=ZWNobyBvawo= --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateClusterNodePool
